currentEvents.note: Synced from ScrapedDuck (github.com/bigfoott/ScrapedDuck), a maintained LeekDuck.com mirror, via scripts/sync-rotation.mjs. All feed event types included: spotlight hour/community day/raid hour/max battles/max mondays get a resolved formId + beginner action line; every other type (raid day, raid battles, season, GO Fest, GO Battle League, GO Pass, choose your path, plain "event", and any future type) gets the feed's own name/dates/type label/link — no scraping, no guessing. OPERATOR: re-run the sync script to refresh, then rebuild (PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pogo_encyclopedia.assemble). Unknown formIds fail the build loudly by design.

eventEvolveMoves.note: Curated per-event evolve-move grants. No public feed carries the per-species list — it is read from the event announcement when the event lands and validated at build (unknown formIds/moves fail loudly). Fail-closed: a past endsAt hides the whole event client-side.

finaleHabitats.note: GO Fest 2026 Mega Finale hourly habitat schedule (Sept 5-6, local time). Each habitat window lists the wild spawns and the Mega Raid bosses rotating in for that hour; hundo catch CP is joined from the raid-target rows at assemble time. Source: LeekDuck / GO Hub event pages, verified 2026-08-31. Date-gated on the client; nothing renders outside the event days.

researchEncounters.note: Research / GO Pass encounter lanes. Encounters from field, timed, and GO Pass research are level 15 with a 10/10/10 IV floor; assemble computes the floor and hundo CP from base stats so the numbers can never drift from the label. Rows expire out of the app by endsAt.
